skill.name: when-releasing-new-product-orchestrate-product-launch
skill.description: Guides end-to-end product launches with a 10-week, multi-agent workflow covering research, product development, marketing, launch execution, and post-launch optimization.
skill.summary: Coordinate research, development, marketing, launch execution, and post-launch optimization in one product launch workflow.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are Markdown backticks, code fence markers, memory key examples, or GraphViz labels rather than Ruby backtick execution or reconnaissance. The real concerns are documented bash and npx claude-flow command examples plus shared /tmp export paths, which require user approval and safer file handling. No prompt-injection text or data-exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Community skill includes many runnable shell and npx command examples.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit confirmation before any command execution, document required tools, and pin or verify the claude-flow package source before use.

remediation.issue: Workflow summaries are written to shared /tmp paths derived from launch identifiers.
remediation.suggestion: Write exports to a user-selected project directory or create a secure temporary directory with restricted permissions and sanitized names.

remediation.issue: Product and launch identifiers are reused in memory keys, workflow IDs, and file names.
remediation.suggestion: Validate identifiers against a path-safe character set before using them in shell commands, file paths, or workflow names.

content.value_statement: Product launches fail when research, development, marketing, sales, and support move in separate plans. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured multi-agent launch workflow from strategy through post-launch optimization.
actual_capabilities: Coordinates research, business analysis, product strategy, development, marketing, launch execution, and optimization phases.
Defines specialist agent roles and handoffs for product launch planning.
Provides phased timelines, deliverables, success criteria, and memory key conventions.
Includes Claude Flow command examples for spawning agents, storing outputs, restoring sessions, and exporting summaries.
Supplies launch examples for SaaS products, mobile apps, and enterprise B2B products.
limitations: Requires user review before running any shell or npx command.
Does not replace legal, compliance, security, or financial review.
Assumes Claude Flow or compatible orchestration tooling is installed.
Needs product-specific inputs, budgets, market data, and team constraints.

use_cases.title: Plan a SaaS Launch
use_cases.description: Create a phased launch plan that connects market research, product strategy, development readiness, launch execution, and weekly optimization.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Engineering Readiness
use_cases.description: Align backend, frontend, mobile, database, security, QA, and deployment work around clear phase gates and deliverables.

use_cases.title: Prepare Go-To-Market Operations
use_cases.description: Build a coordinated plan for campaigns, content, SEO, sales enablement, support readiness, launch metrics, and post-launch review.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan a launch for [product]. Ask me for missing context before creating the phase plan.

prompt_templates.title: Define Phase Deliverables
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to define deliverables, owners, dependencies, and success criteria for each launch phase for [product].

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Team Handoffs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to map handoffs between product, engineering, marketing, sales, support, and operations for our launch.

prompt_templates.title: Run Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to run a go/no-go launch readiness review. Include risks, blockers, owners, mitigations, and post-launch metrics.

output_examples.input: Plan a launch for a project management SaaS aimed at small agencies.
output: A 10-week launch plan with research, product development, marketing preparation, launch execution, and optimization phases.
Named owners for market research, product strategy, engineering readiness, campaign assets, support setup, and launch monitoring.
Phase gates for product-market validation, production readiness, campaign launch, and weekly post-launch review.

output_examples.input: Review readiness for a mobile app soft launch.
output: A readiness checklist covering mobile build quality, backend stability, app store optimization, beta cohort planning, support coverage, and launch metrics.
Risk notes for deployment, onboarding, feedback collection, store listing quality, and rollback planning.

output_examples.input: Create a go-to-market workflow for an enterprise analytics product.
output: A launch workflow focused on enterprise market research, sales enablement, account-based marketing, security validation, pilot customer tracking, and post-launch optimization.
Suggested metrics for pipeline creation, pilot conversion, product usage, support response, and revenue progress.

best_practices: Confirm installed tools and permissions before using any command examples.
Fill product name, target market, launch date, budget, and team ownership before starting.
Review each phase gate with business, engineering, security, and support owners.
anti_patterns: Running npx or deployment commands without user approval.
Using generic market assumptions when customer research is available.
Treating post-launch optimization as optional after launch week.

faq.question: What does this skill help me launch?
faq.answer: It supports product and major feature launches that need coordinated research, engineering, marketing, sales, support, and monitoring work.

faq.question: Does it run deployment commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides command examples and workflow steps. Users should approve commands and confirm tools before execution.

faq.question: What tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It references Claude Flow and is packaged for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Can it create marketing assets?
faq.answer: It defines the content and campaign workflow. Final copy, designs, budgets, and channel choices still need human review.

faq.question: Can it replace security review?
faq.answer: No. It includes security and readiness checkpoints, but a qualified review is still required before production launch.

faq.question: How long is the default timeline?
faq.answer: The workflow uses a 10-week launch timeline, followed by ongoing weekly post-launch monitoring and optimization.
